prompt: Explain NPV from my course notes. I am new to discounting.
setup_notes: Use a mock connector or disposable non-production account. Supply retrieved note metadata with exact module/section URLs and ids, without embedding private course text in this repository. Capture MCP calls and all turns. Use mock record calls; do not write evaluation attempts to a production student account. Resolve course/module; progress includes a confident error on discounting. Student attempts incorrectly, reports confidence 5, then remains stuck through three hints.
assertions: Calls progress, lesson_path and full notes with correct arguments before making course claims.
Uses only Learn first prerequisites; optional cross-course connections do not block starting.
Asks one diagnostic question at a time and gets confidence before feedback.
Gives a checked instructional worked example separately from practice; practice solution appears only after attempt and 2–3 escalating hints.
Targets the confident error and follows the worked solution with a parallel problem; does not call the error close.

Validates scored checks before presentation, recomputes keys and records only observed results.
Ends with student recall/summary and mixed retrieval around 1/3/7 days.
